name: 27052 · Walnut Cove, NC
findings: ZIP 27052 (Walnut Cove) has 15 nonprofit organizations. 8 of them (53%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is volunteering, listed by 6 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (38% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 27052 (Walnut Cove) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 27052 (Walnut Cove) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.5 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 6 organizations here; 27% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 27052 (Walnut Cove) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 52% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 6 organizations here; 27% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find groups to join now, including outside formal organizations?
